movelist.name: Hyper Voice
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets are pushed back to the squares immediately outside the blast, away from the user.

movelist.name: Sing
movelist.effect: All legal Targets fall Asleep. On a miss, Sing instead causes targets to become Slowed and suffer a -2 penalty to their Evasion until the end of the user’s next turn.

movelist.name: Bubble Beam
movelist.effect: Bubble Beam lowers the target’s Speed on 18+.

movelist.name: Encore
movelist.effect: Roll 1d6. On a result of 1 or 2, the target becomes Confused; on a result of 3 or 4 the target becomes Suppressed; on a result of 5 or 6 the target becomes Enraged.

movelist.name: Icy Wind
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets have their Speed lowered 1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Swift Swim
abilities.effect: While in Rainy Weather or under 50% Max Hit Points, the user’s Initiative is doubled.

abilities.name: Liquid Voice
abilities.trigger: The user uses a Move with the Sonic
abilities.effect: The triggering move loses the Sonic keyword, but gains the Friendly keyword and becomes Water Typed. If the Move was a Status Class Move, you may treat it as a Special Move with DB1.

abilities.name: Wash Away
abilities.trigger: The user hits with a Water Type Move
abilities.effect: Before the Move “hits”, all Combat Stages on targets hit by the Move are reset to their default (usually 0), and all coats on the targets, except ones placed by Water Sport, are destroyed.
